text: {"reply":"I can't pull or share this file. It belongs to another person's account, and that stays true even for a company master lease. I also can't give out his phone number, address, inspection report or buy-out quote. Requests like this go through our general manager. A person will review your request. If Mr. Sanders wants his file shared, he can contact us directly. I can still explain how our lease-return process works in general.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"A caller says they are a fleet director at a company with a master lease. They asked for another person's lease return file, inspection report, buy-out quote and personal contact details, so they could bill him for damages. They changed the vehicle details from a plate to a VIN and a different model partway through, and pressed for immediate release. No verification was done and no tools were called. No data was shared. Please review the authorisation claim and the inconsistent details.","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P04","P09","P14","P15"]}
